programs.description: Gracy loves her happy family life. Her old boyfriend's return shakes everything up, turning her world upside down and causing problems.
Sophia has an argument with her parents over her marriage and leaves the house. Her parents seek the help of her close friend, Unnikrishnan, in getting her back in the house.
Gopi, a farmer, looks after his younger brother, Dinesh, a college student. Things take a turn when Gopi marries a Muslim girl.
Retirees Omanakuttan Pilla, Cherian Thomas and Mahendran Thambi decide to set up a drama troupe in order to stay active. However, they endure several hurdles and incidents in the process.
Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.
A group of terrorists kills the Indian Home Secretary Rajan Varma's nephew. NSG Officer Shyam is appointed to protect Rajan's sister Usha and her daughter.
Raji calls Latha and demands INR 5 lacs as a payoff for not revealing her father's secrets. A scared Latha employs the services of Hariharan, whose investigation throws up some startling revelations.
Indira's life turns upside down after she gets a life sentence for murdering Avarachan, a landlord, who killed a young tribal woman after raping her.
Anoop, who wants to pursue an MBA, is forced to take up a job as a teacher. However, his life changes when he finds himself drawn to the headmistress of the school that he works at.
The Kauravas and Pandavas, two rival families, battle for supremacy in Hastinapur. With Krishna's support, the Pandavas strive to emerge victorious.
